[b]December 14, 2027: The Dancing Lady[/b]

The government of Rosenmarkke has released a 1 and a half hour long film to be shown in the theaters of allies and across Rosenmarkke entitled The Dancing Lady, or more formally, The Dancing Lady, Before the Glorious Sun.

The film depicts the story of a beautiful Thrømm princess who, through a strategic union with a wealthy human merchant and a Montfleurois monarch, manages to forge an unstoppable force against a wicked creature known as The Eagle which is ravaging and pillaging the landscape and threatens to destroy entire civilisations. 

The three manage to call upon the heroic citizens of the merchant's hometown, the Montfleurois rulers' kingdom, and the Thrømm kingdom to form an army built up through song and dance. They confront the great eagle, and through the usage of a specially designed bow and arrow, which is shot by the three main protagonists, the eagle is pierced in the heart and burns up into ash. 

The film ends with the citizens who banded together surrounding the Thrømm princess and her allies, dressed in the various historical uniforms of the Rosenmarkket armed forces since the 1600s, singing about the glory of the rising sun, which has begun to rise not from the east or west but from the north. There is a figure in the sun, who is revealed to be none other than Polenne Strømm, who looks at the viewers, her face radiant in the film, and says, We must preserve peace, for the sake of the future. I wish you peace and happiness, dear friends! 

The film is rumored to have cost $50 million to produce, and managed to sell out in cinemas across the country, being mandated to be shown on television for at least one week in Rosenmarkke during primetime.
